name: Head of the Medusa
body:
School transmutation; Level shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a medusa mask worth at least 1,000 gp)

EFFECT

Range self, see text
Effect petrifying gaze
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and don the medusa-head mask.

The eyes in the medusa’s mask glow and its mouth opens in a violent snarl. Any enemy that meets your gaze, must make a Fortitude save or turn into a mindless, inert statue as per the spell flesh to stone. A creature can avert their eyes as with any other gaze attack but you can focus your gaze on a target as a standard action to force a saving throw on them.
